Control: Name the exact RMM tenant, customer, device group, and approved business purpose
Evidence required: Approved change ticket and scoped asset list
Test: Confirm a non-scoped test endpoint is not affected

Control: Record the vendor's current executable, service, path, domain, port, signer, and certificate indicators
Evidence required: Dated vendor documentation or signed installer evidence
Test: Compare captured endpoint telemetry with the documented indicators

Control: Verify the installer source, Authenticode status, signer, certificate chain, and file hash
Evidence required: Download URL, signature result, signer subject, thumbprint, and SHA-256
Test: Reject an unsigned or unexpectedly signed test artifact

Control: Choose the narrowest supported control: signer, hash, path, process, service, domain, port, tenant, or device scope
Evidence required: Documented exception logic and business justification
Test: Prove a similar but unapproved binary remains blocked

Control: Limit egress to documented destinations and ports; avoid broad wildcards where exact destinations work
Evidence required: Firewall or proxy rule export and vendor network requirements
Test: Connect from an approved endpoint and deny a non-approved destination

Control: Limit endpoint exceptions to the documented RMM processes, services, and installation paths
Test: Run install, update, service start, and remote-support tests on a lab endpoint

Control: Bind the exception to approved tenants, organizations, sites, or enrollment tokens where the control supports it
Evidence required: Tenant IDs, site IDs, enrollment scope, and access policy
Test: Attempt enrollment with an unapproved tenant or token

Control: Keep process, network, authentication, remote-session, script, and configuration telemetry enabled
Evidence required: Log-source inventory, retention setting, and sample events
Test: Complete one authorized session and trace it end to end

Control: Suppress only the expected condition and preserve alerts for renamed, relocated, unsigned, or unexpected-parent execution
Evidence required: Before-and-after alert samples and final rule logic
Test: Exercise approved and deliberately mismatched test cases

Control: Document how to remove the exception, isolate endpoints, revoke access, and preserve evidence
Evidence required: Rollback steps, emergency owner, and tested commands
Test: Remove the lab exception and confirm default enforcement returns

Control: Obtain security, endpoint, network, service-owner, and customer approval required by policy
Evidence required: Named approvers, timestamps, ticket link, and residual-risk decision
Test: Confirm the production rule exactly matches the approved draft

Control: Set expiry and review triggers for signer, certificate, domain, executable, agent-version, tenant, or ownership changes
Evidence required: Expiry date, review cadence, source-monitoring owner, and renewal evidence
Test: Revalidate every indicator and remove stale exceptions
